§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Ignition takes 20 seconds at 25,000,000,000 EU/t (12A MAX), consuming 50,000,000 L of helium-3. A hot star continuously consumes 1,000,000 EU/t and 100 L/t of helium-3, even while fusion is paused. Ignition and sustain additionally return half the helium-3 volume as helium plasma.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Each fusion cycle lasts 20 seconds. Remaining power ratio is original recipe seconds ÷ 400, limited to 0.1%–10%. Fusion EU/t = native EU/t × parallel count × this ratio, plus sustain. A 20-second, 1,000,000 EU/t native recipe uses 50,000 EU/t at one parallel, or 1,050,000 EU/t including sustain. Up to 8,196 parallels are constrained by power, materials and output. Sustain failure or lost structure extinguishes the star and requires reignition; use Extinguish in the terminal to end the hot session.
